retirement_and_cleanup_dispositions.target_scope: QMD retired 8B model, partial and parked indexes, and refetch/rebuild units
retirement_and_cleanup_dispositions.ruling_item: qmd Qwen3-Embedding-8B unit: the model, the partial index (759 of 4,957 vectors when attempt-003 stopped), the lane's parked copy, and the lane units that would re-fetch or rebuild it
retirement_and_cleanup_dispositions.original_ruling_gate: Apply step 1 is acked. Order: confirm both timers are disabled (they were at 19:58Z, and the timers.target.wants link is already gone), remove the eight unit files, daemon-reload, reset-failed; only then the model and the indexes, so nothing can re-fetch or rebuild them. With the YAML gone a restart would fall back to qmd's compiled default embedder, embeddinggemma by hf: URI. Before each: zero processes with --index native-agent-stack-catalog-q3e8b and a holder check on the exact files. The 8 GB hash runs at nice 19 outside the closed hours. Keep the lane's logs and receipts.
retirement_and_cleanup_dispositions.ordering: Disable retired timers, remove eight units and reload/reset before model/index cleanup.
exclusions: Retained lane logs and receipts; never restore the retired rebuild.
retirement_and_cleanup_dispositions.state_evidence_class: source_review_of_CC_operation_report; not new independent filesystem observation

Then the CC's own packet (embeddinggemma-cc-packet-20261006T1733Z.json): both files re-checked against the manifest; a full-scope holder re-check; a census that no process or registration uses qmd's default index.
